Kit summary

Soul-draining StrikeBasicExclusive Lv.3
Deals DMG by 26% of Elbek's Max HP to a single enemy. Afterward, gains 2 layers of [Desert Soul]. If this attack lands a Crit, additionally gains a layer of [Desert Soul]. If the target is killed, additionally gains 2 layers of [Desert Soul]. Each layer of [Desert Soul] increases Elbek’s Max HP Cap by 3%, stackable up to 50 layers. This buff will not be removed upon death or wave transition.
Soul Blade&Shield Lv.3Elbek gains [Death Domain] for 3 turns after casting Soul Outburst, during which the layer of [Desert Soul] obtained by casting Soul-draining Strike triples. Meanwhile, extends the duration of [Death Domain] by 1 turn if anyone dies.
Soul GuardActiveExclusive Lv.1
Grants all allies a [Shield] by 35% of Elbek's Max HP for 2 turns.
Soul Blade&Shield Lv.1Soul Guard also grants all allies (excluding self) [Ally Protection]. Elbek will take 30% of the DMG taken by his allies (excluding self) for Elbek’s 2 turns. Meanwhile, Elbek gains [Immortal] for 2 turns.
Psionic CoercionPassive
Reduces Elbek's All Damage Received by 16%, the effect of which increases to 50% when he takes DMG from enemies whose HP is lower than his.
Soul OutburstActiveExclusive Lv.2 · Lv.3
Deals DMG by 54% of Elbek's Max HP to a single enemy. This skill has 25% Leech, and Elbek gains an additional 25% Max HP while attacking with this skill.
Soul Blade&Shield Lv.2Elbek additionally casts Soul Outburst 1 time when he takes Fatal DMG. Elbek is subject to death after this skill.
Soul Blade&Shield Lv.3Elbek gains [Death Domain] for 3 turns after casting Soul Outburst, during which the layer of [Desert Soul] obtained by casting Soul-draining Strike triples. Meanwhile, extends the duration of [Death Domain] by 1 turn if anyone dies.
